$comment: Classification register for official and manufacturer sources of the 993. 'families' records, for each system of the assembly skeleton, at least one qualified source (official or manufacturer, evidence level A or B) and where in it the family is covered. 'Qualified' is a classification by source type and evidence level only: it does not check the copy that was consulted, the pages cited or the values read there. 'sources' records model years and dated availability observations only where a record states them or where this register states its own dated observation; a source absent from 'sources' is not classified, which says nothing about its years or availability. Validated by scripts/validate_registers.py.
rules: Model years are recorded only from text already present in the source record (title, coverage.variants or notes), quoted verbatim; nothing is inferred from the generation alone.
Every availability observation is dated and names the channel it was observed on. It describes that channel on that day, not the market.

Absence of a part number from the Porsche Classic Parts Finder, or from any vendor search, is recorded as not_listed_on_channel. It is not proof that the part or the publication is discontinued; discontinued_per_publisher requires an explicit statement by the publisher.
A listing is not a purchase and not an offer to buy: purchases and subscriptions are owner decisions.
